tile.top_origin_policy: MVP_AUTHORING_DEFAULT; record actual shared top bounds and pivot, do not infer from canvas bottom
tile.grid_basis_note: Use half of the specified 64x32 top for continuous projection; confirm raster alignment in the first visual gate.

placement.already_baked_policy: metadata must record the already baked offset; runtime remainder = target - baked, or normalize source to zero
placement.saved_instance_policy: save logical cell and orientation; resolve render offset from asset contract without cumulative writes
placement.attachment_policy: resolve child from parent visual mount once; do not repeat parent alignment offset on child
placement.stack_anchor_rule: anchor_y(level n) = 16 + 32*(n-1); level 1 anchor = 16, each higher level = +32px in canvas y; resolved once from parent top mount

generation_sheet_policy.rule: one generation call produces ONE uniform grid sheet; every cell identical pixel size (supersampled >=4x of final 64x64); each cell contains exactly one asset or one animation frame; extraction slices the FIXED GRID (no contour detection) then scales each cell to final 64x64; per-component arbitrary rescale forbidden; cell fill ratio must be consistent across all cells
generation_sheet_policy.static_jobs: batch multiple 64x64 assets per sheet where practical
generation_sheet_policy.animation_jobs: one sheet per (asset,state): all 12 frames x required directions on a single uniform grid (existing 12-frame single-sheet policy)
generation_sheet_policy.extraction: grid-slice by declared rows/cols; reject sheets whose cells differ in size or whose subject scale varies beyond tolerance

pixel_quality.rule: final 32x32 cells must be real pixel art: palette-quantized and pixel-snapped. A smooth resampled render downscaled to fit is a defect.
pixel_quality.required_steps: sprite-gen pixel_snap_scale + palette quantize/recolor before approval; plain LANCZOS downscale alone is REJECTED

reference_conformance.rule: raw generations are REFERENCES, not sources to shrink. Final 32x32 cells are produced by deterministic code path (sprite-gen pixel_snap+quantize/recolor, or code-drawn raster like TileArt) and must measure conformant to their reference before approval.
reference_conformance.metric: per-cell silhouette IoU vs reference + palette/color match; score recorded in provenance per approved cell
reference_conformance.metric_detail: silhouette IoU rebuilt through the frame's committed ref_map (block coverage >= coverage_threshold over the mapped raw region) plus palette match: share of the cell's opaque pixels whose 5-bit-per-channel color bin is populated by the reference's mapped region
